What Dynatrace says to expect

  • Fiscal year 2027: Arize acquisition effectThis guidance reflects the expected contribution from the Arize acquisition, including approximately 200 basis points of ARR growth accretion and 175 basis points of dilution to non-GAAP operating margin for fiscal 2027.
  • Fiscal year 2027: foreign exchange effectWe expect foreign exchange to be a headwind of approximately $20 million on ARR and approximately $6 million on revenue for fiscal 2027 compared to ARR and revenue at constant currency.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 3, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
